subject: Civil Engineering
title: Detention and Retention Basins
description: One-minute skill: Detention and Retention Basins.

hook.text: That empty pond behind the shopping mall isn't decorative — it catches floodwater.

buildup.text: Detention basins store runoff temporarily and release it slowly through a small outlet.

discovery.text: They reduce the peak flow downstream — spreading a sharp spike into a gentle curve.

twist.text: Retention basins keep a permanent pool — they also treat runoff by settling sediment.

climax.text: Most cities require new developments to include stormwater detention — zero net runoff increase.

punchline.text: Hold the water, slow it down, and the flood never reaches downtown.

quiz.question: How do detention basins reduce downstream flooding?
options: They permanently remove water from the watershed through evaporation
They store runoff temporarily and release it slowly, reducing peak flow
They redirect stormwater to a different watershed entirely
